summary: This note is a short biographical entry on Zhu Qinan, a Chinese male sport shooter born November 15, 1984 in Wenzhou, Zhejiang. It records his Olympic results, winning gold in the Men's 10 m Air Rifle at the 2004 Athens Olympics and silver in the same event at the 2008 Beijing Olympics. It also notes that he is currently studying at Zhejiang University.
one_line: Chinese sport shooter who won Olympic gold (2004) and silver (2008) in the Men's 10 m Air Rifle.
key_facts: Zhu Qinan was born on November 15, 1984 in Wenzhou, Zhejiang.
Zhu Qinan is a male Chinese sport shooter.
Zhu Qinan won the gold medal at the 2004 Athens Olympics in the Men's 10 m Air Rifle event.
Zhu Qinan won a silver medal at the 2008 Beijing Olympics in the Men's 10 m Air Rifle event.
Zhu Qinan is currently studying at Zhejiang University.
